title: US2 T034+ implementation lane opened with ArticleProjection contract gate
summary: A stacked T034-T041 implementation lane is opened from the latest T032/T033 tests-first head. The first T034/T035 vertical slice is blocked until the conflict between the T032 assertion shape and the canonical ArticleProjection OpenAPI shape is explicitly resolved.
